verdict.rationale: Navan's in-product AI assistant, Ava, is documented as analyzing spend data, providing insights, summarizing spend by month and category, comparing spend to policy, and proactively suggesting savings. Hotel search also shows a data-driven "price to beat" target. The MCP server offers similar analysis, but only through external AI tools, so it counts as supporting rather than core evidence. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on how Ava surfaces insights in the UI (the evidence is a marketing blog post), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the insights and suggestions work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ava slices and dices real-time spend data, provides insights into T&E questions, and proactively finds opportunities for savings.
Analyze travel spend and craft suggestions to save
Summarize travel spend by month and by category
Analyze travel spend and compare it to company policy
Navan shows employees a "price to beat" for every hotel  search — a smart target based on location, date, and demand that's under their policy limit.
